# certloom_template (Resource)

A certificate template: the issuer, key type, SAN rules and renewal settings that deployments inherit. The server rejects a template that existing deployments would violate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "certloom_template" "public_web" {
  name     = "public-web"
  document = <<-EOT
    apiVersion: certloom/v1
    kind: CertificateTemplate
    metadata:
      name: public-web
    spec:
      issuer: ${certloom_issuer.letsencrypt.name}
      challenge: http-01
      keyAlgorithms: [ecdsa-p256]
      sans:
        allowed: ["*.example.com", "example.com"]
        maxNames: 10
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `document` (String) Template document in YAML (`kind: CertificateTemplate`), for example from `file()`.
- `name` (String) Template name. Must match `metadata.name` in the document.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier assigned by certloom.
- `version` (Number) Current template version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id, as shown by the certloom CLI or API.
terraform import certloom_template.example <id>
```
